response.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as count FROM manager_award GROUP BY player_id), total_awards AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM manager_award) SELECT a.player_id, a.count, a.count * 1.0 / t.total as fraction FROM award_counts a CROSS JOIN total_awards t WHERE t.total > 0 ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
